thread:
zoe (platform): quick brain dump: propose a "compact-snapshot" flow for transient debug captures. idea: keep smallest safe signal for reproducing failures without storing plaintext. sketch below.

arpit (eng-ml): sounds useful. what format were you thinking? full token text still risky.

zoe (platform): compact snapshot = {metadata (route, model, seq_len), compressed token-id diff vector, redaction summary (types/counts), topk_context_signatures}. never store raw spans. max snapshot size 1KB.

molly (privacy): echo: love the minimal approach. mandatory automated PII redaction at capture time. if a PII pattern matches, replace with <REDACTED:TYPE> and record rule_hash and redaction_version.

ben (support): support needs: sometimes masked preview (first char + ****) is enough to confirm issue. allow request-unmask button but gated.

anya (prod): quota risk: tenants could DoS our storage with noisy snapshots. propose per-tenant snapshot_quota_bytes + burst_limit and console throttle. also emit quota_exhausted event.

ci-bot: rollout queued: feature/compact-snapshot -> staging canary

arpit (eng-ml): implementation tip: store token-id counts + changed indices + small top-3 candidate tokens for each changed index (encrypted). this gives reconstruction signal without full text.

molly (privacy): reversible unmasking must be strictly gated: HSM unwrap, legal ticket id, operator MFA, RBAC group "audit-unmask". unmasked snapshots must have TTL (default 7d) and be audited.

zoe (platform): API sketch (server authority mandatory):
POST /v1/responses
Headers:
  Authorization: Bearer <$TOKEN>
  x-redwood-snapshot-mode: compact|full|off
  x-redwood-inspect-reason: canary|debug
Body: {"prompt":"..."}

arpit (eng-ml): note: token.claims.snapshot_allowed must gate compact creation for enterprise tokens. header is advisory.

ben (support): console UX list:
- snapshot_sample_rate
- snapshot_quota_used / snapshot_quota_bytes
- last_snapshot_time
- redaction_version
- unmask_requests (with status)
allow async unmask request button that records reason and ticket id.

molly (privacy): unmask workflow: operator must be in RBAC "audit-unmask"; action logs operator, time, ticket, TTL; unmasked artifact auto-deletes after TTL; KMS/HSM audit event emitted on unwrap.

anya (prod): telemetry suggestions: snapshot_created_total, snapshot_bytes_histogram, snapshot_redaction_hits_total, snapshot_unmask_requests_total, snapshot_unmask_latency_ms_p95, snapshot_quota_exhausted_total. alert on snapshot_quota_exhausted_total > 0 for >5m.

arpit (eng-ml): perf target: compact mode should add <3% p99 latency overhead. will build prototype with compressed token-id vectors and bench.

molly (privacy): final policy addendum: no plaintext emails/phones/SSNs in any stored blob. if detected, redact and increment snapshot_redaction_hits_total. periodic audit job to sample stored snapshots and validate redaction rules.

zoe (platform): action items:
- (arpit) prototype compact snapshot format + perf bench (2w)
- (molly) draft unmask gating doc + legal checklist (this week)
- (anya) quota+console mockups + alert rules (EoW)
- (ben) list top support cases requiring unmask examples (EoW)

ci-bot: calendar invite created: "compact-snapshot design review" tomorrow 10:30 PT

zoe (platform): thanks all 44d

ci-bot: deploy step: canary cluster updated (logs -> /deploys/compact-snapshot)
